services.name: School Groups
services.desc: The Alabama Music Hall of Fame provides an educational and engaging experience for students from pre-K through 12th grade. Guided tours are available for school groups with advance reservations. Educators may also lead their groups independently through the exhibits. We offer interactive scavenger hunts and trivia

blurb: The Alabama Music Hall of Fame was a dream and goal of the Muscle Shoals Music Association, a Shoals area based professional organization of recording studio owners, producers, musicians, songwriters and other music professionals.
